# external/CMakeLists.txt
add_library(external INTERFACE)

# --- Header-only libraries ---
target_include_directories(external INTERFACE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Eigen
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/GLM
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/KHR
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/nlohmann
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/stb
)

# --- GLAD (C source file) ---
add_library(glad STATIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/GLAD/glad.c)
target_include_directories(glad PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/GLAD)

# --- ImGui ---
add_library(imgui STATIC
    imgui/imgui.cpp
    imgui/imgui_draw.cpp
    imgui/imgui_tables.cpp
    imgui/imgui_widgets.cpp
    imgui/imgui_demo.cpp
    imgui/imgui_impl_glfw.cpp
    imgui/imgui_impl_opengl3.cpp
)
target_include_directories(imgui PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui
)
target_link_libraries(imgui PUBLIC glad)

# --- Prebuilt Assimp ---
add_library(assimp SHARED IMPORTED)
set_target_properties(assimp PROPERTIES
    IMPORTED_IMPLIB ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assimp/lib/assimp-vc143-mtd.lib
    IMPORTED_LOCATION ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assimp/bin/assimp-vc143-mtd.dll
)
target_include_directories(assimp INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assimp/assimp)

# --- Prebuilt zlib ---
add_library(zlib STATIC IMPORTED)
set_target_properties(zlib PROPERTIES
    IMPORTED_LOCATION ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/zlib/lib/zlibstaticd.lib
)
target_include_directories(zlib INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/zlib/zlib)

# --- Combine into one interface target ---
target_link_libraries(external INTERFACE glad imgui assimp zlib)
